blocs.sous_titre: We pick each technology to fit your custom development project, never out of habit.
Building custom software raises questions. Here are our answers before you call.

questions.question: How much does custom software cost?
questions.reponse: It depends on the scope, and that's exactly why we start by talking it through. After a first conversation, we give you a clear estimate, no strings attached. You know what you're getting into before you decide.

questions.question: How soon do we see something concrete?
questions.reponse: We reply within 48h of your first contact. On the project side, you see the first mockups within a few weeks and a testable version soon after, thanks to our short iterations.

questions.question: What happens after delivery?
questions.reponse: We don't disappear. We handle maintenance, evolutions and security over the long term. Our clients stay with us for years, and that's our best indicator.

questions.question: Which technologies do you use?
questions.reponse: We master a wide range of modern, proven technologies (Angular, Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, Docker, Kubernetes...), and we choose based on your context, not our preferences. The goal: a durable tool that your teams or others can pick up.

questions.question: Custom or off-the-shelf software: how do I know?
questions.reponse: If an off-the-shelf tool covers your need, we'll tell you honestly. Custom makes sense when your processes are specific and no existing solution truly respects them.
